test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The coach asked us when we were planning to begin practice.

options.text: “When will you to begin practice?”, the coach asked us.
“When do you plan to begin practice?”, the coach asked us
“When are you planning to begin practice?”, the coach asked us.
“When did you planning to begin practice?”, the coach asked us.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In direct speech, the tense and structure of the sentence must accurately reflect the **original spoken words.**
 
• The coach's question should be framed in the present continuous tense to match the context of** "planning."**
 
• The correct direct speech form is: **“When are you planning to begin practice?”**
 
• This ensures that the sentence retains its original meaning and context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When are you planning to begin practice?", the coach asked us.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** “When will you to begin practice?” – Incorrect tense and structure.
 
• **Option 2:** “When do you plan to begin practice?” – Incorrect tense; doesn't match the context.
 
• **Option 4:** “When did you planning to begin practice?” – Incorrect tense and structure.
